info.title: Trading Grid for Retail: supplier connection (draft)
info.description: Draft API behind the customer-assistant connection. Generated from the tool list the demo MCP server registers, so the two cannot drift. Every operation is read-only except POST /v1/proposals, which records an approval-gated proposal and changes nothing until an authorized user approves it in Trading Grid. All data is fictional.

get.description: Ashby orders with Northfield that need action at a point in time: rejected documents, and required documents not sent as their deadline nears. Each item carries the reason, the Northfield rule and its source, the deadline, the time left and a link to the order record. Set include_warehouse to add the Kinross shipping advice (945). Also lists items checked that need nothing.

get.description: The rule catalogue Ashby works under, each rule with its owner (Industry standard, US law, Northfield, Ashby, Ashby agreement), the Northfield rule an Ashby rule implements, its basis and source, and the precedence statement saying which rule wins. Covers Northfield’s supplier guide 2026.2 (deadlines, field limits, item and location rules, charges, evidence and scorecard rules), Ashby’s own policies and its Kinross and marketplace agreements. Filter by rule id or charge code, topic words, or X12 document number.

post.description: For one exception, reads the Supplier ERP, warehouse, carrier and Trading Grid records and returns the next step with the evidence behind it and what a fixed rule would have done. Jobs: missing_document (record: PO), deduction (record: case id), trade_test (record: test ship notice), shelf (record: store number), shipment_risk (record: PO), scorecard (record: "YYYY-MM-DD to YYYY-MM-DD", optional). It proposes; it sends and changes nothing.

post.summary: Request a change in Trading Grid
post.description: Use when the user asks to send, resend, correct, approve or change anything. In this release the connection is read-only: it answers "Action not available" with the Trading Grid record where an authorized user completes and approves the action. With writes enabled it records an approval-gated proposal instead; nothing changes until Priya Raman approves it in Trading Grid.
